description: Target ownership and dependency policy for src/services. All service implementation files must live inside an explicit module-owned path.

shared.purpose: Browser-safe primitives shared across service modules: hashes, ids, errors, config contracts, serialization helpers.

platform.purpose: Host/platform adapters and browser-safe runtime utilities: provider clients, telemetry, resource pools, browser acceleration, runtime feature detection. Browser-safe entrypoints live in browser.ts; host-native process/filesystem wrappers live in host.ts.

mcp.purpose: MCP protocol, registries, descriptors, event DAG provenance, policy broker, transport, and schema/UI descriptor orchestration. Browser-safe descriptor/envelope/schema entrypoints live in browser.ts; host transports, discovery, trust, and CLI wrappers live in host.ts.

glasses.purpose: Meta-glasses/orb/webapp control surfaces, adapters, widget compilation, and display/input/audio/camera profiles.

ipfs.purpose: IPFS interface descriptors, UI profiles, widgets, and storage/cache integration points.

logic.shared.purpose: Common theorem-prover domain types, formula analyzers, parsers, validation, canonicalization, and proof metadata.

logic.api.purpose: Stable logic-layer facades, end-to-end validators, and public orchestration APIs that compose multiple logic modules.

logic.nl.purpose: Natural-language parsing, policy compilation, multilingual parsers, grammar loading, and sentence-level conversion helpers.

logic.fol.purpose: FOL parsing, formatting, conversion, export, symbolic FOL helpers, and FOL-specific syntax validation.

logic.tdfol.purpose: TDFOL core AST, parser, prover, temporal/deontic APIs, strategy routing, optimization, and performance helpers.

logic.dcec.purpose: DCEC core types, grammar/parsing, prototypes, integration, and DCEC-specific error handling.

logic.cec.purpose: CEC/Event Calculus rules, tableaux, fluents, context, proof cache, and CEC prover management.

logic.deontic.purpose: Deontic parsing, norm IR, formula building, legal-text extraction, conflict detection, and normative graph projection.

logic.modal.purpose: Modal codec/compiler/decompiler/tableaux, Kripke structures, KG bridges, ambiguity handling, and modal synthesis.

logic.bridges.purpose: Cross-logic bridge adapters and graph/multiview projections across FOL, TDFOL, CEC, DCEC, modal, and deontic views.

provers.purpose: Concrete prover adapters and prover-facing serializers for Z3, CVC5, Coq, Lean, DCEC, TDFOL, Lurk, STARK, and neural prover bridges. Browser-safe entrypoints live in browser.ts; host-native wrappers live in host.ts.

zkp.purpose: ZKP statements, circuits, proving backends, browser ZKP, UCAN bridge, on-chain bridge, artifacts, witness/key management. Browser-safe entrypoints live in browser.ts; host-native artifact/toolchain wrappers live in host.ts.

proof-engine.purpose: Proof execution, proof trees, proof strategies, caches, explainers, formula dependency graphs, and proof-engine contracts.

integrations.purpose: External/optional integration wrappers: FLogic, ErgoAI, ShadowProver, spaCy WASM, neurosymbolic services, UCAN policy bridges.
